source_line_json: " * The catalog message IDs for the pre-runtime CLI text.\n"
" * These IDs are catalog-only: they have no entry in `human-messages.ts`, whose\n"
" * `CliMessageId` table and English table remain the byte-identity oracle for\n"
" * the pre-existing error and argument messages. The catalog is the source of\n"
" * truth for these new messages, so the English output lives in\n"
" * `locales/en/cli.ftl` and the identifier rule (a stable dotted ID has no\n"
" * hyphen) is enforced by `scripts/check-locales.mjs` for this table too.\n"
" * `defaultCatalog` resolves the English bundle once, so a renderer called\n"
" * without a resolved catalog (a unit test, for example) still renders from the\n"
" * catalog rather than from a second copy of the English text.\n"
"/** Command-report options plus the resolved catalog a human renderer reads. */\n"
"/** Stable catalog IDs for the newly migrated pre-runtime text. */\n"
"\t// `doctor` diagnoses. The renderer rebuilds each message from these IDs at\n"
"\t// render time, so the `--json` report keeps its English machine text.\n"
"\t// `doctor` problems. Same render-time mechanism as the warnings: the report\n"
"\t// keeps the English machine text while the human text localizes.\n"
"\t// Catalog source credential, discovery, and attempt text. The token\n"
"\t// variable name, HTTP status, and endpoint URL are arguments; the attempt\n"
"\t// results feed the human attempts summary, so they are catalog text.\n"
"\t// `doctor` field values. A status or channel word a user reads is text, not\n"
"\t// data, so it is a catalog message. The report keeps the English value while\n"
"\t// the human renderer resolves the same ID in the active locale.\n"
"\t// `keybindings` portability warnings, status, policy, and bootstrap messages.\n"
"\t// The plan's `portabilityWarnings`, `status`, and `policy` stay English in\n"
"\t// `--json`; the human renderer resolves these IDs instead.\n"
"\t// `self-update` field values. The policy and install-channel enums are shown\n"
"\t// in the doctor fields and in `self-update status`; the report keeps the raw\n"
"\t// English token while the human renderer resolves these IDs in the locale.\n"
"\t// Hand-written `UsageError` messages that are not parser errors.\n"
"\t// Jouzu renderer: startup notice, banner labels, help overlay, and the\n"
"\t// first-run profile prompt. The keybinding values the overlay and banner\n"
"\t// show are resolved at render time and injected, never catalog values.\n"
"\t// The work dashboard's flow units. A unit label is a short state word in a\n"
"\t// narrow column, so it stays a phrase rather than a sentence.\n"
"\t// Palette key-bar actions and shared view labels. The key itself is a resolved\n"
"\t// binding injected at render time; only the action label is catalog text.\n"
"\t// The model picker's remaining rows, status messages, notifications, and\n"
"\t// startup labels. Model IDs, provider IDs, keybindings, and error detail are\n"
"\t// passed as arguments; only the sentence moves here.\n"
"\t// The Models row markers and the picker's empty state, plus the three error\n"
"\t// sentences a `catch` passes to `ctx.ui.notify(…, \"error\")`. A provider/model\n"
"\t// identifier and the catalog name stay protected values passed as arguments.\n"
"\t// The picker's remaining failure text. Its failure callbacks throw these to\n"
"\t// `ModelPickerComponent`, whose message area renders the message verbatim (a\n"
"\t// selection) or as the `{ $detail }` of a refresh failure.\n"
"\t// The Workflow view's rows and confirmations.\n"
"\t// The rest of the Workflow view's display: the stage suffixes, the section and\n"
"\t// group headings, the field values, and the panel's status and error text. The\n"
"\t// mode and section values (`browse`, `agents`, `runs`, `parallel`) are internal\n"
"\t// identities that stay in code; only the display word is catalog text. Counts\n"
"\t// and resolved bindings are passed as arguments.\n"
"\t// The Workflow text that issue #53 moved off the human-facing APIs: the\n"
"\t// `perform` and `openText` labels, the `detail` field labels, the form and\n"
"\t// run errors, the title, and the inline hint. `perform`, `openText`, and\n"
"\t// `detail` take a `CatalogMessageRef`, so a raw literal no longer\n"
"\t// The TextGuard review view's other-list hints.\n"
"\t// The rest of the TextGuard review overlay: the decision actions, the mode\n"
"\t// confirmations, the severity and verdict lines, and the notification and\n"
"\t// approval sentences. The `/textguard` command, the finding kinds, and the\n"
"\t// severity values are protected values passed as arguments, never catalog\n"
"\t// text. The approval wording is marked for the privacy/safety review.\n"
"\t// The TextGuard notification sentences the local `notify` helper shows, and\n"
"\t// the two alert frames a local helper returns. The `/textguard` and `/reload`\n"
"\t// command names, the mode values, the finding source, and the already-resolved\n"
"\t// report or approval sentence are protected values passed as arguments or kept\n"
"\t// The Settings view. A key-hint label is a short word in a narrow column; a\n"
"\t// row label is the identity column; the messages are the panel's status and\n"
"\t// confirmation text. Key names and resolved keybindings are passed as\n"
"\t// The form's field labels, its auth-type choices, the refresh result, and the\n"
"\t// About view's scroll hint. `None` and `Bearer token` are the displayed words\n"
"\t// The Settings panel text that a conditional expression used to hold: the\n"
"\t// transport warning prefix, the save and context-ceiling notices, the\n"
"\t// dashboard address, the form headings, the credential hints, the account\n"
"\t// row, the sign-in recovery, the auto-label state, and the view names. The\n"
"\t// state words (the credential state, the auto-label state) are select\n"
"\t// variants keyed by an internal value; the view names stay English as\n"
"\t// Palette product nouns, by the owner decision.\n"
"\t// The Settings Language view: three items with their effective value and the\n"
"\t// source that supplied it, plus the Settings-only preview controls.\n"
"\t// The first-run language choice: the self-names, the candidate markers, the\n"
"\t// two prompts, and the save reports.\n"
"\t// The Settings text that issue #53 moved off the plain-`string` seams: the\n"
"\t// token warning and save notes, the account row, the section heading, the\n"
"\t// empty states, the title, and the sign-in reports. The sign-in `report`\n"
"\t// closure takes a `CatalogMessageRef`, so a raw literal no longer\n"
"\t// The voice surface: the recording widget, the microphone picker, the command\n"
"\t// notices, and the reviewed capture and transport diagnostics. The internal\n"
"\t// subcommand names, and the `[garbled]` marker are protected values, never\n"
"\t// catalog text; a state word is a select variant keyed by the internal value.\n"
"\t// The transcript's reviewed diagnostics and the two command descriptions. The\n"
"\t// transcript throws these through `voiceError`, so the voice surface resolves\n"
"\t// the active locale instead of the English text `VoiceError.message` keeps.\n"
"\t// The shisa-link authentication onboarding, device-flow, and logout surface.\n"
"\t// The command names, account identifiers, URLs, and device codes are passed\n"
"\t// The subagent result renderer. The internal run state values (queued,\n"
"\t// running, and the rest) are the keys of the status table and never change;\n"
"\t// only the display word moves here. Dynamic values (run IDs, paths, model\n"
"\t// IDs, tool names, counts, offsets) are passed as arguments.\n"
"\t// The subagent command, workflow, and dashboard notifications. Command names,\n"
"\t// option words, JSON operation snippets, run IDs, paths, and counts are\n"
"\t// passed as arguments; only the sentence moves here.\n"
"\t// The subagent launch, resume, read, and trace failure and recovery sentences\n"
"\t// the direct-string detector cannot reach. A model, a provider, a role, a\n"
"\t// workspace, a run ID, a byte offset, and a JSON operation snippet are passed\n"
"\t// as arguments; only the sentence moves here. The subagent tool's own command\n"
"\t// description and call preview are human-facing chrome and move here too.\n"
"\t// The flow-control surface. Tool labels, flow-status diagnostics, and the\n"
"\t// admission and recovery reasons a person reads in the status report move\n"
"\t// here; command names, paths, and provider messages are passed as arguments.\n"
"\t// External user-input receipts. A receipt carries a machine reason code beside one\n"
"\t// display sentence, so the code stays stable while the sentence resolves from the\n"
"\t// session bundle. `flowSubmissionUnavailable` above is the shared callback-ended reason.\n"
"\t// The grants-file display reasons a denied external-input authorization reports.\n"
